claims.text: BCG-osis (negative blood cultures don't exclude it): antituberculosis drugs (ethambutol, isoniazid, rifampicin) + PO steroids;
claims.quote: Negative blood cultures do not exclude the diagnosis, as BCG-osis is still found in about 40% of such cases. Treatment involves antituberculosis medications (ethambutol, isoniazid, and rifampicin) and oral steroids.

claims.text: antituberculosis tx typically continues ≥ 3 to 6 months.
claims.quote: Antituberculosis treatment is typically continued for at least 3 to 6 months.
